en: A vintage Russian postal card with handwritten cursive text in ink. At the top center is printed text in red and on the left a red imperial double-headed eagle emblem. In the top right corner there is a red postage stamp with the Russian imperial coat of arms, canceled by two black postmarks dated 1904. The card is addressed in Russian and includes the destination city written as St. Petersburg.
